---
title: "Data Governance"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

This project concerns private health data. Repository access and FASRC storage
controls are necessary but do not decide what may enter a release.

Before source inspection or curation begins, a human data steward must record:

- the authoritative source location and custodian;
- whether files contain direct or quasi-identifiers;
- approved users and computational locations;
- permissible row- and geography-level release grain;
- masking, aggregation, and small-cell rules;
- retention and deletion requirements;
- the reviewer who authorizes publication.

These are scientific and governance decisions, not infrastructure defaults.
Until they are recorded, Pipeline pages deliberately stop at inventory and
scaffolding. Do not include values, screenshots, tables, or summaries derived
from protected data in the rendered Manual.
